g.text: The lookup's extra loss without the address, beyond a random part, on varied scenes
Diamond: the address fit on simple scenes, compared after the data; circle: refit, fixed in advance.
9B, 27B, Muse: fixed in advance, ●. Lightning: the same rule, its circles hollow. Hollow marks: Lightning's
gate chosen after the 60-scene pre-check was seen.
Omitted: Muse JSON, too few switches (29).
